title: Congestion-aware tier gatekeeper with credit rebalancing
creator: Priya Singh
description: Problem: During peak usage windows paid and enterprise customers see higher latency and throttling despite reserved capacity; free-tier traffic contributes to head-of-line congestion in regional edge routers. Goal: implement a congestion-aware admission gate that enforces stepped precedence across plan tiers (free -> paid -> enterprise) while allowing fleeting credit borrowing and automatic rebalancing to reduce aborts and preserve SLOs for higher-tier customers. This ticket implements the gatekeeper, the credit rebalance algorithm, and the regional demotion policy that selects compatible fallback model variants when capacity is constrained.
acceptance_criteria: Edge admission controller rejects or demotes requests according to tier precedence under congestion and preserves enterprise SLA in 90th percentile latency tests.
Credit rebalancer runs every 10s and can borrow up to configurable fraction between paid and free buckets without violating reserved entitlements.
Fallback model selection happens automatically for demoted requests with model-variant compatibility guarantee (same tokenizer / output schema).
Integration tests demonstrate no more than 2% increase in paid-tier request aborts under 5x synthetic flood from free-tier compared to baseline.
Dashboard shows per-tier admission, rebalancer actions, regional spillover counts, and correlates with latency SLOs.
Design/PM signoff on UX for quotas shown in Console is recorded in linked Confluence doc.
technical_notes: Admission model: token-bucket per tenant per tier with global soft-reserve windows for enterprise plans.
Rebalancer: epoch-based allocator that moves credits from underutilized paid pools to starving paid pools, and allows limited grace borrowing from free pools subject to debt ceilings.
Demotion: when admission fails, system attempts FIFO-compatible fallback variants (e.g., quantized/4-bit or shorter-context variant) before returning 429/abortion.
Region-aware routing: prefer same-region capacity; on regional exhaustion, consider spill to secondary regions only for paid/enterprise and only if latency delta < configured threshold.
Consistency: credit state kept in Redis with optimistic CAS and periodic reconciliation job to handle cross-cell drift.
Trade-offs: borrowing reduces isolation guarantees for free tenants but materially reduces costly aborts. We cap borrowing and surface debt to Console.
implementation_steps: 1) Add admission gate API and config knobs to edge proxy (PR #5643).
2) Implement per-tenant, per-tier token buckets and persistence layer (redis keys, CAS).
3) Implement epoch rebalancer service + CLI flags for tuning (initially 10s epoch, borrow cap 15%).
4) Integrate fallback-model selector using model-variant registry and compatibility matrix.
5) Add telemetry (Grafana) panels and alerting rules for unexpected debt growth or cross-region spillover.
6) E2E integration tests and chaos scenarios (free-tier flood, region outage).
7) Gradual rollout: feature flag behind beta toggle -> canary in a single region -> global enable.
test_plan: Unit tests for token-bucket semantics and CAS failure/retries.
Integration test: simulate mixed traffic (70% free, 25% paid, 5% enterprise) and validate admission decisions.
Load test: 5x free-tier flood to measure paid/enterprise 99th/95th latency before and after rebalancer.
Fault injection: Redis failover and stale credit reconciliation to ensure safe defaults (reject rather than over-allocate).
Regression: ensure existing regional routing fallbacks are not broken by the new gatekeeper.
rollout_plan: Canary: enable in single dev-region for 24h with traffic shadowing for one high-value customer.
Staged rollout: enable for paid + enterprise only in three regions, monitor debt and SLOs for 72h.
Full enable: open to free-tier with conservative borrow limits and increase windows gradually if stable.
Rollback: toggle off gatekeeper or set borrow cap to 0; automated script to reconcile credits post-rollback.
monitoring_kpis: credit-debt growth and per-tenant borrow counts
cross-region spillovers and added latency delta
fallback-variant usage and output-quality regression alerts
